nagarI 6 pattanam 7 pawwanam 8 pawwanI 9 puwaBedanam 10 pawaBedanam 11 sTAnIyam 12 nigamaH 13 ityamaraBaratO ॥ kawakam 14 pawwam 15 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ kecittu nagarapattanasTAnIyAnAM BedamAhuH । tatra purAditrayaM pure । pattanAdidvayaM pattane । sTAnIyAdidbayaM sTAnIye । iti manyante । yatrAzwaSatagrAmIyavyavahArasTAnaM maDyavartti tat nagaram । yatra rAjA tatparicArakASca tizWanti tat pattanam । prAkArAdinA durgaM yojanavistIrRaM nagaraM sTAnIyam । kecittu puranagarayorapi BedamAhuH । bahugrAmIyavyavahArasTAnaM puram । tatra praDAnaBUtaM nagaram । iti BarataH ॥ * ॥ aTa nagaranirmmARakAlaH । “sTirarASigate BAnO candre ca sTiraBodaye । SudDe kAle dine cEva nagaraM kArayennfpaH ॥” * ॥ tasya lakzaRaM Bavizyottare । “dIrGaM vA caturasraM vA nagaraM kArayennfpaH । tattryasraM varttulaM vApi kadAcidapi kArayet ॥ dIrGaM pAdEkaprasaraYcaturasraM samocitam । triBiH pAdEH samaM tryasraM varttulaM balayAkfti ॥ dIrGaM syAddIrGakAlAya suKasampattihetave । caturasraM caturvargaPalAya pfTivIBujaH ॥ tryasraM triSaktinASAya varttulaM bahurogakft । rAjYaH svahastErdaSaBI rAjahasta udAhftaH ॥ rAjahastESca daSaBI rAjadaRqa udAhftaH । rAjadaRqESca daSaBI rAjacCatramudAhftam ॥ rAjacCatrESca daSaBI rAjakARqa udAhftaH । rAjakARqESca daSaBI rAjapUruza ucyate ॥ rAjaDAnI tu kaTitA daSaBI rAjapUruzEH । rAjaDAnI daSaguRA rAjakzetramudAhftam ॥ saptEva parimARAni proktAni purapattane । BayatrABogasampattimarttyakIrttisuKArTinAm । rAjakzetreRa nfpatiH pUrapattanamAraBet ॥ lakzmIrjayaH kzamA sOKyaM paYcatvaM BaNga ekatA । samfdDivittaM nASaSca maNgalaYca balaM kzayaH । sAmrAjyaM Bogasampattiriti zoqaSa kIrttitAH ॥ yaTArTasaMjYA nagarA muninA tattvavedinA ॥” iti yuktikalpataruH ॥ * ॥ api ca । “nfpAvAsaH purI proktA viSAmpuramapIzyate । ekato yatra tu grAmo nagaraYcEkataH sTitam ॥ miSrantu KarvvawaM nAma nadIgirisamASrayam । viprASca vipraBftyASca yatra cEva vasanti hi ॥ sa tu grAma iti proktaH SUdrARAM vAsa eva ca । paRyakriyAdinipuREScAturvarRyajanEryutam ॥ anekajAtisambanDaM nEkaSilpasamAkulam । sarvvadEvatasambanDaM nagarantvaBiDIyate ॥” iti vizRupurARawIkAryA SrIDarasvAmiDftaBfguvacanam ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “nagaraM sarvvatoBadraM karttavyaM roDakaM hi vA । svastikaM maDyagaM kAryyaM kumArIpurameva vA ॥ catuzpaTacaturyuktaM sarvvakAmasuKAvaham । CinnakarRaM vinAsaYca duHsTitaM kfSadurbbalam ॥ nagaraM na praSaMsanti garttavidDaM viBeditam । agrataH svalpaprAsAdaM CinnaGrARaM vidurbuDAH ॥ dbimuKaM karRahInantu kfSamaDyaM kfSaM viduH । duHsTitaM nimnayAmyantu nErftaM Danadurbbalam ॥ sOmyaM sarvvasuKAhlAdapUritaM vAruRaM vaSam । yAmyamAyuHpradaM pUrRanagaraM prItivardDanam ॥ ISavAsavasaMpUrRaM sarvvArogyasuKapradam । maDyaYcatuzpaTopetaM na ca taM pIqayet kvacit ॥ brahmasTAnaM hi taM vipra Sivastatra sadA sTitaH । caturvviMSatinAqyastu hastAnyazwaSataM param ॥ atra maDyaM praSaMsanti hrasvotkfzwavivarjjitam । aTa kizkuSatAnyazwO prAhurmuKyaM niveSanam ॥ nagarArdDaYca vizkamBaM KewaM grAmaM tato'rdDataH । nagarAdyojanaM KewaM KewAdgrAmo'rdDayojanaH ॥ dvikroSaM paramA sImA kzetrasImA caturDanuH । triMSadDanUMzi vistIrRo deSo mArgastu tEH kftaH ॥ viMSadDanurgrAmamArgaH sImAmArgo daSEva tu । DanUMzi daSa vistIrRaH SrImAnrAjapaTaH kftaH ॥ nfvAjiraTanAgAnAmasambADaH susaYcaraH । DanUMzi cEva catvAri SAKAraTyAstu nirmmitAH ॥ trikarAScoparaTyAstu dvikarApyuparaTyikA ।
